company.name: Simbi.com
company.shortDescription: Simbi provides a community virtual currency for freelancers and independent workers to turn their unbooked hours into real economic value.
company.description: Simbi is an online marketplace that runs on talents, services, and skills, not cash, credit, or check. Founded in 2015 and based in San Francisco, Simbi provides a way for freelancers and independent workers to turn their unbooked hours into real economic value. Simbi simultaneously increases the size of the economy while supporting small-scale entrepreneurs to do the flexible work they love.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,200,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,656,420 to $6,608,730, a 1.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
